notes: Half-life phase: the Results sentence reports only 'half-lives', but the Discussion explicitly calls the same measurement 'the serum elimination half-life of TRAIL-ATNCs in mice', so half_life_phase is set to 'elimination' on the basis of that body sentence rather than by inference. No two-phase model, no absorption half-life and no rate constant appear in the body. No Cmax, tmax or AUC is reported because the assay produced relative (densitometric) serum concentrations rather than absolute values. Dose is expressed in the body as a concentration plus injection volume (0.01 or 1 mg/mL in 200 microL saline) with no mg/kg equivalent for the PK study, and is recorded that way. STRAIN INCONSISTENCY INSIDE THE BODY: Methods state the PK study used 'BALB/c wild type mice (8 weeks old)', while the Results paragraph refers to 'The half-life value for native TRAIL in nude mice obtained here'; both statements are flagged rather than reconciled. Sequences: the full TRAIL-ATNC sequence is not printed, but the body does print the component peptide/linker sequences (IL4rP CRKRLDRNC, MMP2 site GPLGLAG, linkers GGGSG, GSGGGSG, EALQGQVQHLQAAFSQYKKVELFP, GGGGAEAAAKEAAAK); the long sequences in the PEPLIFE2 header are database metadata and were not used. Curation rule applied: procedural and imaging substances are documented here rather than listed as agents - FPI-774 NIR dye conjugates of TRAIL/TRAIL-ATNC/TRAIL-ATNCIL4rP used for biodistribution (0.54, 0.5 and 0.31 mg/mL i.v.), d-luciferin (150 mg/kg) for bioluminescence imaging, 2,2,2-tribromoethanol (250 mg/kg i.p.) and isoflurane as anaesthetics, and the anti-DR4 (AF347) / anti-DR5 (CDM234) blocking antibodies and control IgGs used only in vitro.
